headline: Asian Development Bank Approves $500M Loan for Pakistan Pension Reforms
summary: The Asian Development Bank approved a $500 million results-based loan to help Pakistan reform its federal civil pension system and contain rising fiscal pressures.
why: Multilateral development loans support fiscal consolidation and structural reform programs in developing member countries.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Development loans provide fiscal relief and support structural public sector reforms.
